title: Our Family Meals
text:
In our house, we eat breakfast together at seven o'clock. We have bread, eggs and milk. At lunch, my father eats rice and chicken. I like lunch too.

In the evening, we have dinner at home. Dinner is my favorite meal. Tonight, my mother is making soup and salad. After dinner, we wash the dishes together.

questions.text: What time do they have breakfast?
How does the writer feel about dinner?
options: She does not think about it

questions.text: Why do they wash the dishes together?
options: Because they share the work at home
Because they are going to a restaurant
Because they do not have any plates
Because they want to buy new dishes

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day
a warm liquid food made from meat, vegetables, or other ingredients
plates, cups, and bowls used for food

paragraph_translations: Evimizde kahvaltıyı saat yedide birlikte yaparız. Ekmek, yumurta ve süt yeriz. Öğle yemeğinde babam pilav ve tavuk yer. Ben de öğle yemeğini severim.
Akşamları evde akşam yemeği yeriz. Akşam yemeği en sevdiğim öğündür. Bu akşam annem çorba ve salata yapıyor. Yemekten sonra bulaşıkları birlikte yıkarız.
